title: Modular A/V: Starter set
description: Voice and video for Foundry VTT in one install: the Modular A/V dock, LiveKit and noise cancellation, with the camera background (blur or a picture) offered. It holds no code of its own: it brings in those modules, which you can still turn on and off one by one.

recommends.reason: Blur your background or replace it with a picture.
